description: AbstractMqttPublisherActor.java defines an abstract class for MQTT publisher actors using HiveMQ in a Java-based project. It encapsulates common logic for MQTT message publishing, including mapping external messages to MQTT messages, extracting topics and payloads, and handling acknowledgements. The class is designed to be extended for specific MQTT versions (e.g., MQTT 3 or 5).

classes.name: AbstractMqttPublisherActor
classes.description: An abstract base class for MQTT publisher actors using HiveMQ, providing core functionalities such as message mapping, topic extraction, payload retrieval, and acknowledgement creation. Designed to be extended for specific MQTT protocol versions.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToMqttMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to map an ExternalMessage to an MQTT message (generic type P) with specified QoS and target information.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the MQTT topic string from a message of type P.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the payload ByteBuffer from a message of type P, if available.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates a Props object for creating an AbstractMqttPublisherActor, parameterized with the connection, HiveMQ client, and dryRun flag.

methods.name: toAcknowledgement
methods.description: Converts a Signal and broker result into a Ditto Acknowledgement object.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines whether an acknowledgement should be published based on its label.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Adds behavior for handling messages during the receive setup, particularly for dry run mode.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Placeholder for additional receive handling logic after main setup (empty in this base class).

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts an address string into an MqttPublishTarget object.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Handles publishing messages to MQTT, including mapping external messages, logging, invoking the MQTT client, and processing acknowledgements.

methods.name: determineQos
methods.description: Determines MQTT QoS level based on the target's QoS setting or defaults.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Checks whether the actor is in dry run mode.
